title: Milk Me Not
description: Rate and discover plant-based milks. Find your oat. Judge every blend.
tagline: Ditch the Moo. Find Your New.
detail: A plant-based milk review app built for people who take oat milk seriously. Browse ratings, compare blends, and figure out which milk actually belongs in your coffee. Built because the answer to "which oat milk is best" shouldn't require a Reddit deep-dive.

title: Folio
description: Personal finance — crypto, gold & ETFs in one local-first view.
tagline: Your money. Your numbers. No subscriptions.
detail: A personal finance dashboard built for people who want to see everything in one place without handing over bank credentials. Crypto, gold, ETFs — tracked and backed up to your own Backblaze bucket. No third-party accounts, no monthly fee, no dark patterns. Just a clean view of where things stand.

title: Peter & Co.
description: This site. A self-contained React portfolio with a live theme switcher.
tagline: A playground, not a business. Yet.
detail: A single-file React app built as a hub for experiments and side projects. No build step, no framework overhead — just Babel in the browser, inline styles, and a theme system that lets you flip between named, versioned looks at runtime. The whole thing is a side project about side projects.

title: Boer Transport
description: Rebuilt the website of a friend's family transport company — 140+ years of history, zero mobile support.
tagline: 140 years of moving things. Now the site moves too.
detail: A refresh of the website for CV Transportbedrijf L. Boer & Zn. — a family container transport company from Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel, active since 1878. The old site had been untouched for years. Rebuilt it clean: same character, mobile-friendly, no frameworks. Deployed on Netlify via GitHub with the contact form handled by Netlify Forms.
